name: Ancient Dragon
description: A fearsome dragon that has awakened from its slumber. Its scales shimmer with magical energy, and its breath can melt stone.

name: Forest Guardian
description: A massive treant that has been corrupted by dark magic. Once a protector of the forest, it now seeks to destroy all who enter its domain.

name: Kraken of the Deep
description: A colossal sea monster with tentacles that can crush ships. It has risen from the ocean depths to terrorize coastal villages.

name: Undead Lich King
description: A powerful necromancer who achieved immortality through dark rituals. He commands an army of the dead and wields devastating magic.

name: Elemental Titan
description: A massive being formed from the four primal elements: earth, fire, water, and air. Its power is unmatched in the mortal realm.

name: Shadow Demon
description: A terrifying entity from the realm of shadows. It feeds on fear and can manipulate darkness to its will.

name: Celestial Phoenix
description: A divine bird of immense power that has been corrupted by chaos magic. Its flames burn with both creation and destruction.

name: Mountain Colossus
description: A giant made of living stone that has slumbered for centuries. Now awakened, it threatens to reshape the land with its immense strength.

name: Arcane Construct
description: A magical creation designed by ancient wizards as the ultimate weapon. It has broken free from its creators' control and now seeks to absorb all magic in the world.

name: Chaos Dragon
description: The most powerful dragon in existence, capable of manipulating reality itself. Its mere presence warps the fabric of the world around it.
